therapy_processes.name: Acceptance Process
therapy_processes.description: Increasing willingness to contact unwanted internal experience without immediate control or escape.
therapy_processes.change_logic: Short-term distress may rise while long-term flexibility and valued action increase.

therapy_processes.name: Defusion Process
therapy_processes.description: Changing the relationship to thoughts so they can be observed without literal obedience.
therapy_processes.change_logic: Thoughts lose behavioral command value while choice and perspective return.

therapy_processes.name: Surrender
therapy_processes.description: Allowing experience to unfold with reduced struggle rather than forcing immediate control or resolution.
therapy_processes.change_logic: Reduced struggle can open contact with emotion, meaning, and present-moment awareness.

therapy_processes.name: Emotional Breakthrough
therapy_processes.description: A shift from suppression or avoidance into direct, supported contact with previously blocked emotion.
therapy_processes.change_logic: Blocked affect becomes accessible within safety, often enabling integration and meaning repair.

therapy_processes.name: Self-Compassion Process
therapy_processes.description: Replacing punitive self-evaluation with warmth, common humanity, and balanced support.
therapy_processes.change_logic: Threat-based self-relation softens, reducing shame maintenance and behavioral rigidity.
